localProcedure.captivity: Actual magically caused Unconscious is meaningful captivity: no movement/speech/Action/BonusAction/Reaction, unaware, drops held items to current physical support, Prone where physically legal, automatic STR/DEX save failure, attacks against advantage and adjacent hits critical. End concentration on admission; preserve item ownership/custody/position and physical fall/landing consequences. Nightmare content remains private, supplies no false real bodies or caster knowledge. Body/flight/support prerequisite failures hold physical consequences rather than inventing a landing.
localProcedure.ending: Each admitted target independently WIS at regular END even while asleep or suppressed. Success ends all components of that owner's application. Source concentration ending/death, target final death, eligible dispel or absolute60second expiry also ends it. If caster is inside and becomes incapacitated, its concentration ends immediately, cleaning remaining applications and preventing later components that require a live source. Process targets in fixed admission order declared before rolls. True Seeing recognition alone is not a free Action or waking trigger; exact stronger immunity remains separately honored. Family/phase clock clauses apply.
localProcedure.resolution: NEW initial WIS: success creates no record or damage; failure creates private nightmare plus separately real4d10 psychic immediately and at future actual regular target STARTs, family.weird exposure, concentration up to60elapsed seconds. Resolve first damage/lifecycle before admitting magically caused Unconscious on eligible survivors. Sleep/Unconscious defenses and hard-denial marks separately gate the captivity; blocked sleep leaves the admitted psychic damage record, not a replacement stun/fear state.
localProcedure.selection: RP9-Q17 A; Q18 A; Q19 A.
localProcedure.targeting: KEEP Core30ft and native30ft radius. NEW fixed initial snapshot of all creatures whose actual occupied bodies intersect the full3D30ft sphere at a point within30ft, with caster-to-point and point-to-body line of effect. Include caster/allies and concealed creatures; area damage does not disclose their identity/location. Later entrants are not admitted and leaving is not an escape tether. Actual Wizard/Enchantment route only.
localProcedure.wake: NEW explicit self-damage exception: psychic damage from this same root does not wake its own captivity. Positive post-temp damage from any other root (including a different Weird), or an adjacent helper's legal Action and physical contact, ends this root's sleep component only. External damage must resolve completely before wake; tempHP-only damage does not meet this chosen wake rule. No new sleep admission after waking, immunity loss or suppression. Prone, dropped equipment, damage and independent Unconscious sources remain. Sleep immunity blocks only sleep; fear immunity blocks nothing here; exact mental-illusion protection may cover the whole application only when its text does.

repair182Clarifications.budgetAccounting: Action/BonusAction/Reaction fields are unspent source allowances, not automatic permission to act. Incapacity blocks eligibility without spending those allowances. Actual regular starts refresh and tick recharge even when incapacitated; death is separately marked inactive. Removing incapacity never refunds a spent allowance.
repair182Clarifications.damageDefenses: Resolve exact paid defense components separately. Sanctify resistance/fear modes do not union. True Seeing recognizes false imagery without canceling separate damage/control. Mind Blank uses its exact accepted psychic/mental spell scope and willingness; no consent is invented for an unconscious target.
repair182Clarifications.sourceQualification: All new actor builds, conditional dice and geometry are explicit static witnesses. No actual campaign acquisition, creature anatomy, authoritative CR, hidden observer knowledge or runtime availability is created. Accepted comparison status may coexist with blocked catalog runtime selection; current authored index binding controls only its recorded authored scope.
repair182Clarifications.unprovedExtraTurn: The procedure has no acquired genuine full-extra-turn example. The required positive extra-turn branch stays whole-case held and this identity remains unaccepted. Actual ordinary, attached, multiple-owner and suppression ledgers are not relabeled as full extra turns.

sharedProcedure.commitment: Action,V/S/F; ordinary range and identity checks precede commitment. Choose school variant and any Reality Break mode before paying. Cast spends once. Area membership is snapshotted at manifestation. Ready pays and resolves cast side effects at setup, holds concentration, expires next actual regular own START, and releases once with a legal Reaction after trigger; targeting occurs then. Effect clocks begin at manifestation; no second cast/cost/strain at release. Source component failure, countering, interruption, replacement or expiry refunds nothing already committed.
sharedProcedure.control: Before new Stunned or Unconscious admission, resolve survival, actual condition defenses and source-character/target encounter hard-denial allowance. Spend the combined mark once only upon successful new whole-Action denial. Used allowance blocks that new rider only; independent damage remains. No downgraded substitute control or repeated attempt after immunity/suppression. Existing admitted control may resume for its remaining original duration if a suppressor ends; no new costs, mark, duration or fresh side-effect such as another item drop. Full Stunned and Unconscious semantics apply, including ending concentration, no Actions/BonusAction/Reaction, movement prohibition, specified automatic saves and attack consequences. Frightened/flight/slow are not whole-Action denial.
sharedProcedure.eligibility: Before commitment bind actor identity, class level, acquired repertoire/prepared matrix, actual class-school row, component availability and focus custody, current life/body, Action eligibility, rank gate and RP. Rank9 minimum class17 and native base26 RP in every route. School placement alone gives no acquired route. Revalidate target/range/line of effect at manifestation. A paid legal cast whose targets later fail remains spent; an illegal precommit attempt spends nothing.
sharedProcedure.geometryAndInformation: NEW for these enemy-selective spells: designated enemies are creatures the caster currently perceives and regards as hostile; no objective allegiance oracle. Snapshot ALL qualifying designated enemies in the declared geometry without optional post-roll omissions. A mistaken hostile is affected. A concealed unknown enemy is not discovered. Allies/self are excluded unless perceived hostile designation actually applies; Weird instead snapshots every creature including self, allies and unperceived bodies in its area with source line of effect. Use actual occupied body geometry/full 3D, range and total-cover segments. Unknown scene/body/cover facts hold the affected admission, not invented coordinates.
sharedProcedure.packet: One independent damage roll per target per damage event, declared before outcomes, not one shared roll across targets. Binary saves use actual DC/modifiers and advantage/disadvantage, no generic natural1/20 save exception. Save half rounds down before defenses; resistance once, immunity separately, then tempHP, normalHP, instant death, Wound save/injury, zero-HP lifecycle, concentration and living riders in accepted order. No event silently selects Wound/injury/death dice. Hold at the next unavailable input. Surviving damage is never rolled back by rider resistance, awakening, illusion recognition, dispel, suppression, expiry or source death.
sharedProcedure.phaseBridge: For target-bound recurring records use actual regular target START damage and END saves. A source-supported companion without an independent regular turn uses its single attached controller-phase START/END once per controller regular turn; controller changes cannot add an exposure or move an existing expiry. Extra/attached actions confer no extra periodic marker. Outside initiative use initial packet then six-second START/END opportunity pairs (packet then save); transition maps each first unresolved opportunity to the next lawful marker without duplicating exposure. Actual grant, controller and phase must be bound; missing genuine extra-turn/companion evidence is held.
sharedProcedure.qualifications: No runtime execution, human play, balance judgment, cosmology decision, domain closure or release approval. No world-ending, new planes, summoned beings, memory extraction, hidden knowledge, creature anatomy, campaign immunity, acquisition or revival authorization follows from these names or authored fixtures.
sharedProcedure.recurringFamily: NEW explicit local extension of the P20 family/exposure interface for Mass Phantom Killer and Weird only: one packet per named family/recipient/actual numbered round, across owners and including an initial packet. Earliest active eligible application wins; ties use application order then immutable source ID. Mark the family opportunity before defense/HP resolution; losing due applications lose that opportunity. Suppressed sources lose their own due packet, cannot bank it, but do not consume another active source's opportunity. Independent ending WIS saves survive suppression. Family histories survive recasts/ownership copies. Mass Phantom Killer, Weird and Greater Phantasmal Killer are three distinct families.
sharedProcedure.resources: Use actual RP, Dissonance, Refrain, surcharges, class discounts and active passives. Base strain rank9=2; Wizard first distinct prepared underlying family=0 base only. Subsequent immediate same-name casts add capped Refrain1/2/3. No generic Overcast. First-cast exceptions never reset by copies, changing school, Ready release, suppression or new recipients. Keep resource history. No assumed reductions or kill-resource farm.
sharedProcedure.roots: Every cast has an immutable source owner, class/school, rank, component roots and target admissions. Child damage retains original root, funding, type and Null provenance; a Null-qualified hit preserves its actual recipient lifecycle restriction and cannot acquire a final-death/head-destruction side path. Damage, private perception, body consequence, fear, stun, sleep, voluntary flight and forced displacement are separate records. A source covering only one component affects only that component. No unsourced generic mental immunity or all-effects dispel.
sharedProcedure.scope: NEW PF181 spell-local authored selections for exactly the seven IDs. Native text/access is copied intact in each procedure. Proposed overrides of Instantaneous recurrence metadata and missing saves/durations are labeled; no global authority is asserted.
sharedProcedure.termination: Concentration ends on actual failure, incapacitation, death, voluntary ending or replacement unless an acquired specific exception applies. For non-concentration target conditions source death does not itself reset/erase their finite virtual endpoints. Target final death removes living conditions, not physical remains or ledger. Dispel ends only its eligible selected source root. Suppression blocks covered active components while clocks, mandatory saves and independently scheduled actors continue; no missed pulse, flight, forced displacement or head consequence replays on resumption. At an absolute maximum deadline expire before a coincident packet.
sharedProcedure.timing: Each actor owns its actual regular START/END calendar; spell damage opportunities are separately registered. At START expire due start effects and Ready, refresh Reaction and regular budgets, tick recharge, process legal absolute recovery and required death save before spell start effects and voluntary decisions. END resolves due damage/saves/maintenance then end expiry. Six-second virtual source/target markers preserve old durations across initiative change/removal; extra Actions/extra turns never create a regular marker, recharge tick or death save. A pulse is not an actor turn. Do not use one universal pulse rule.

Effect clocks begin at manifestation; no second cast/cost/strain at release. Source component failure, countering, interruption, replacement or expiry refunds nothing already committed.
sharedProcedure.control: Before new Stunned or Unconscious admission, resolve survival, actual condition defenses and source-character/target encounter hard-denial allowance. Spend the combined mark once only upon successful new whole-Action denial. Used allowance blocks that new rider only; independent damage remains. No downgraded substitute control or repeated attempt after immunity/suppression. Existing admitted control may resume for its remaining original duration if a suppressor ends; no new costs, mark, duration or fresh side-effect such as another item drop. Full Stunned and Unconscious semantics apply, including ending concentration, no Actions/BonusAction/Reaction, movement prohibition, specified automatic saves and attack consequences. Frightened/flight/slow are not whole-Action denial.
sharedProcedure.eligibility: Before commitment bind actor identity, class level, acquired repertoire/prepared matrix, actual class-school row, component availability and focus custody, current life/body, Action eligibility, rank gate and RP. sharedProcedure.geometryAndInformation: NEW for these enemy-selective spells: designated enemies are creatures the caster currently perceives and regards as hostile; no objective allegiance oracle. Snapshot ALL qualifying designated enemies in the declared geometry without optional post-roll omissions. A mistaken hostile is affected. A concealed unknown enemy is not discovered. Allies/self are excluded unless perceived hostile designation actually applies; Weird instead snapshots every creature including self, allies and unperceived bodies in its area with source line of effect. Use actual occupied body geometry/full 3D, range and total-cover segments. Unknown scene/body/cover facts hold the affected admission, not invented coordinates.
sharedProcedure.packet: One independent damage roll per target per damage event, declared before outcomes, not one shared roll across targets. Binary saves use actual DC/modifiers and advantage/disadvantage, no generic natural1/20 save exception. Save half rounds down before defenses; resistance once, immunity separately, then tempHP, normalHP, instant death, Wound save/injury, zero-HP lifecycle, concentration and living riders in accepted order. No event silently selects Wound/injury/death dice. Hold at the next unavailable input. Surviving damage is never rolled back by rider resistance, awakening, illusion recognition, dispel, suppression, expiry or source death.
sharedProcedure.phaseBridge: For target-bound recurring records use actual regular target START damage and END saves. A source-supported companion without an independent regular turn uses its single attached controller-phase START/END once per controller regular turn; controller changes cannot add an exposure or move an existing expiry. Extra/attached actions confer no extra periodic marker. Outside initiative use initial packet then six-second START/END opportunity pairs (packet then save); transition maps each first unresolved opportunity to the next lawful marker without duplicating exposure. Actual grant, controller and phase must be bound; missing genuine extra-turn/companion evidence is held.
sharedProcedure.qualifications: No runtime execution, human play, balance judgment, cosmology decision, domain closure or release approval. No world-ending, new planes, summoned beings, memory extraction, hidden knowledge, creature anatomy, campaign immunity, acquisition or revival authorization follows from these names or authored fixtures.
sharedProcedure.recurringFamily: NEW explicit local extension of the P20 family/exposure interface for Mass Phantom Killer and Weird only: one packet per named family/recipient/actual numbered round, across owners and including an initial packet. Earliest active eligible application wins; ties use application order then immutable source ID. Mark the family opportunity before defense/HP resolution; losing due applications lose that opportunity. Suppressed sources lose their own due packet, cannot bank it, but do not consume another active source's opportunity. Independent ending WIS saves survive suppression. Family histories survive recasts/ownership copies. Mass Phantom Killer, Weird and Greater Phantasmal Killer are three distinct families.
sharedProcedure.resources: Use actual RP, Dissonance, Refrain, surcharges, class discounts and active passives. Base strain rank9=2; Wizard first distinct prepared underlying family=0 base only. Subsequent immediate same-name casts add capped Refrain1/2/3. No generic Overcast. First-cast exceptions never reset by copies, changing school, Ready release, suppression or new recipients. sharedProcedure.roots: Every cast has an immutable source owner, class/school, rank, component roots and target admissions. Child damage retains original root, funding, type and Null provenance; a Null-qualified hit preserves its actual recipient lifecycle restriction and cannot acquire a final-death/head-destruction side path. Damage, private perception, body consequence, fear, stun, sleep, voluntary flight and forced displacement are separate records. A source covering only one component affects only that component. sharedProcedure.scope: NEW PF181 spell-local authored selections for exactly the seven IDs. Native text/access is copied intact in each procedure. Proposed overrides of Instantaneous recurrence metadata and missing saves/durations are labeled; no global authority is asserted.
sharedProcedure.termination: Concentration ends on actual failure, incapacitation, death, voluntary ending or replacement unless an acquired specific exception applies. For non-concentration target conditions source death does not itself reset/erase their finite virtual endpoints. Target final death removes living conditions, not physical remains or ledger. Dispel ends only its eligible selected source root. Suppression blocks covered active components while clocks, mandatory saves and independently scheduled actors continue; no missed pulse, flight, forced displacement or head consequence replays on resumption. At an absolute maximum deadline expire before a coincident packet.
sharedProcedure.timing: Each actor owns its actual regular START/END calendar; spell damage opportunities are separately registered. At START expire due start effects and Ready, refresh Reaction and regular budgets, tick recharge, process legal absolute recovery and required death save before spell start effects and voluntary decisions. END resolves due damage/saves/maintenance then end expiry. Six-second virtual source/target markers preserve old durations across initiative change/removal; extra Actions/extra turns never create a regular marker, recharge tick or death save. A pulse is not an actor turn. Do not use one universal pulse rule.
